title: Killip Classification
sources: Killip T, Kimball JT. Am J Cardiol 1967

changelog.change: Content audit Batch 4 housekeeping: added missing tags[] field. No content changed.

purpose: Quick bedside heart-failure severity / mortality estimate in acute MI. Also an input to GRACE.

tiers.label: Class I
tiers.description: No clinical signs of heart failure

tiers.label: Class II
tiers.description: Rales / crackles, S3 gallop, or elevated JVP

interpretation.label: Mortality rises monotonically by class
interpretation.detail: Use as a triage and prognosis anchor; feeds the GRACE model.
